sections.label: Electrical services for homes and small businesses
text: Electrical services for homes and small businesses
From a single extra socket to a full rewire, our qualified electricians handle domestic and light commercial work across Uxbridge and the surrounding counties.
Full & Partial Rewires
Complete or partial rewiring for older properties and renovations, carried out with minimal mess and disruption to your home.
EV Charger Installation
OZEV-compliant home and workplace EV charge point installations, wired safely and sized correctly for your vehicle.
EICR & Safety Inspections
Electrical Installation Condition Reports for homeowners, landlords and businesses, with clear, plain-English reporting.
Consumer Unit Upgrades
Modern fuse box and consumer unit replacements to bring older installations up to current wiring regulations.
Fault Finding & Repairs
Tripping breakers, dead sockets or flickering lights — we diagnose and fix electrical faults quickly and safely.
Lighting Design & Installation
Downlights, outdoor lighting, smart lighting and garden electrics designed and fitted to suit your space.
Landlord Safety Certificates
EICR certification and remedial work for landlords, helping you stay compliant with rental property regulations.
Smoke & Heat Alarms
Mains-wired smoke, heat and CO alarm installation to current building regulation standards.
Commercial Electrical Work
Office fit-outs, shop and small business installations, periodic testing and ongoing maintenance contracts.

text: Straightforward, reliable electrical work
We built RMP Electrical on the basics done well: turn up on time, explain the work clearly, and price it fairly.
NICEIC Registered
All work is carried out to current wiring regulations and certified where required.
Free, Fixed-Price Quotes
No call-out charge and no vague estimates — you'll know the cost before we start.
Fully Insured
Comprehensive public liability insurance for complete peace of mind on every job.
Tidy, Respectful Work
We treat your home or premises with care and leave every job site clean and tidy.
24/7 Emergency Callout
Electrical emergencies don't wait for office hours, so neither do we.
Family-Run Business
A small, local team that relies on repeat customers and word of mouth — not a call centre.
